_comment: Tier-2 for skfem nonlinear#5 (previously 'claim inherited'). Measured on skfem 12.0.1 with the stiff -lap u + exp(u) = 200 problem on MeshTri().refined(3)/P1 from a zero initial guess: full steps (alpha=1) make the residual GROW by nearly three orders of magnitude on the first step and it never recovers within the iteration budget; halving backtracking gives a monotone decrease to machine precision. Thresholds and monotonicity only, no residual pinned. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 makes the alpha=1 branch inside run() take the backtracking path instead, i.e. applies the documented line-search fix to the undamped run. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 4 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 'full_step_residual_grows=True' and 'full_step_never_reaches_1e_9=True' so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
